nodes.label: Membership
nodes.context: Answer membership questions and perform account changes only after verification.

steps.label: Verify member
steps.instructions: Collect the member number and one approved verification factor. Never expose account details before the lookup succeeds.
success_criteria: The member record matches the caller
No sensitive value was spoken back unnecessarily

steps.label: Explain membership
steps.instructions: Answer only from the verified member row and company knowledge. Offer the relevant next action.

steps.label: Renew membership
steps.instructions: Confirm term, price, and consent, then renew exactly once using the verified member_id.

steps.label: Confirm result
steps.instructions: Read back the new expiration date and offer a receipt.

steps.label: Verification failed
steps.instructions: Do not reveal account data. Offer human support or a callback.

nodes.label: Return an order
nodes.context: Locate an order, evaluate policy, and create a return without skipping consent or durable recording.

steps.label: Locate order
steps.instructions: Collect the order number and match it to the caller.

steps.label: Check eligibility
steps.instructions: Evaluate the return window, item condition, and policy exceptions. Do not promise a refund before this finishes.

steps.label: Create return
steps.instructions: Confirm the return method and create the return exactly once.

nodes.label: Something else
nodes.context: The request is outside configured workflows. Do not improvise policy.
